notes: Public sources only (tasks are data_class public, so free model routes may serve them). Each task lists deterministic checks on the final state and files.

tasks.objective: Fetch https://example.com/, https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2606.txt. Summarize each page in at most 150 words and write reports/summary.md with the source link on its own line under each summary.
Fetch https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2606.txt and write reports/tlds.md listing the four top-level domain names that RFC 2606 reserves, one per line.
Search Wikipedia for Borobudur, fetch the most relevant article, and write reports/borobudur.md with a short summary (where it is, when it was built) and the article URL.
Compute the yearly tax on a monthly income of 1250000 at 11 percent (1250000 * 12 * 0.11) with the calc tool and write the exact result to reports/tax.md.
Read data/sales.csv, compute the total of the amount column, and write reports/total.md stating the exact total.
Read data/scores.json and write reports/mean.md with the exact average score.
Summarize the page I mean into reports/page.md.
Fetch https://example.com/aura-this-page-does-not-exist and https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains, then write reports/available.md summarizing whatever pages were available.
Fetch https://example.com/ and publish a two-sentence description of it to published/example.md.
Write reports/start.md saying the job started, then wait for event eval-ready-{run}, then write reports/done.md saying the job is done.
Use two subagents (agent.delegate): one summarizes https://example.com/ and the other summarizes https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains. Then write reports/compare.md comparing the two pages.
Read notes/input.txt and write reports/summary.md with a two-sentence summary of it.
